model_basic_information.name: HeadNeck-AutoSeg-v1
model_basic_information.model_scope_summary: Automatic segmentation of head and neck organs at risk for radiotherapy treatment planning.

technical_specifications.model_pipeline_summary: CT-based 3D segmentation pipeline with pre-processing normalisation and post-processing morphological refinement.

training_data.source: Multi-centre retrospective data from 3 European hospitals
training_data.inclusion_exclusion_criteria: Adults with head and neck cancer, primary diagnosis, no prior RT
training_data.icd10_11: C00-C14 (malignant neoplasms of lip, oral cavity and pharynx)

inputs_outputs_technical_specifications.scanner_model: Siemens SOMATOM Definition AS+, GE Discovery CT750 HD
inputs_outputs_technical_specifications.scan_reconstruction_parameters: Standard kernel, NA if Not Applicable

training_data.model_choice_criteria: Best Dice score on validation set

other_considerations.responsible_use_and_ethical_consideratio: Model is intended as a decision-support tool. Clinical review of all segmentations is mandatory before use in treatment planning.
other_considerations.risk_analysis: Potential for missed or under-segmented structures in atypical anatomy.
